description: In one isolated worktree at jido HEAD 8b936d91d5d40230fe7a9c59d882157a3aa4ce6c, run 10 sequential Elixir quality rounds. Each round must inspect a bounded surface, confirm only evidence-backed findings, apply only objective fixes or eligible safe refinements, run focused proof, and record the result. Finish with the configured repository gates and independent verification. Do not change public contracts, dependencies, thresholds, ignores, or the dirty main tree.

comments.text: Round 1/10 format-drift: mix format --check-formatted passed; no finding.
Round 2/10 compile-warning: project compilation with --warnings-as-errors passed. Local Elixir 1.20/OTP 29 emitted dependency-only warnings and one Mix xref deprecation; no owned-code finding.
Round 3/10 credo-finding required gate: mix credo --strict --min-priority higher passed with 0 issues across 1,049 files.
Round 4/10 credo advisory: verified EXQ-0001 in batch EXQ-B-20261104-01. Replaced a one-clause with/else with case in Jido.Codec.Issue; focused Credo clean, 2 tests passed, formatter passed.

Round 5/10 dialyzer-warning: verified EXQ-0002 in batch EXQ-B-20261104-02. ShutdownPlugin now returns Supervisor.child_spec/0; Dialyzer has 0 unignored warnings, 12 focused tests passed, formatter passed.
Round 6/10 duplicate-code: mix ex_dna --max-clones 17 passed at the established 17/17 clone baseline; no new root cause and no safe automatic extraction.

Round 7/10 architecture-policy-violation: mix reach.check --arch --smells passed the architecture policy. Reach reported 276 advisory smells, but no enabled project rule makes them failures; no automatic source change.

Round 8/10 test-arbitrary-sleep: recorded open judgment finding EXQ-0003 for three fixed 10 ms ReplyGate coordination waits. No automatic fix: done/1 has no acknowledgement, and a safe barrier changes the internal process protocol or test contract.

Round 9/10 proof: quality.contract passed 8 tests; quality.coverage passed at 93.1726% with 323/323 Covenant obligations; corrected quality.report passed all 10 required offline suites. Initial report failure was explained by nonstandard MIX_BUILD_PATH and was corrected by standard-path property and fuzz runs.
Round 10/10 integrated gate: mix quality passed. Contract tests 8/8, required Credo 0 issues, Dialyzer 0 unignored warnings with 26 expected skips, ExDNA 17/17 baseline, Reach architecture OK.

Independent verification: PASS for the uncommitted candidate at base 8b936d9 plus source diff sha256 666d59a04794ecfca106868fd9cd0bfaea3cde26b637e27936167619e47202dd. Combined focused tests 14 passed; full formatter and git diff checks passed; quality CSV validation passed. EXQ-0003 remains open for owner judgment. Task stays in progress pending commit authority.

title: Run 10 quality review and fix rounds
